classDirection.pose: pommel near lower-centre-left, head upper-right, approximately 10 to 20 degrees right lean
proportionRules: total length approximately 70 to 80 percent of Sword
compact head approximately 20 to 25 percent of mace length

references.purpose: Painterly finish, honest wear, material response, cold key, restrained warm rim, floor, and midnight-charcoal background only; do not transfer Remy or her design.
Mace upright-on-end pivot, facing, and right diagonal only; lengthen the haft, keep a compact head, and re-scale to the v2 framing target instead of copying proportions or old framing.

presentation.subject: one-complete-object-or-required-pair
presentation.composition: Use the class anchor for angle, pivot, facing, and camera. Re-scale toward the 8% composition target and never below the 5% hard minimum; establish that corrected occupancy consistently across the class. Present the item upright or on-end; never lie it flat on the floor plane and never mirror the anchor.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Aim for 8% clearance, never cross the 5% hard minimum, and preserve the class pose once the minimum is met.
The image contains exactly the required object, pair, or four Armour components.
The silhouette reads immediately as the declared Equipment class.
Camera, pivot, normalized scale, and presentation angle match the class lock.
Construction, joins, fastenings, grip, coverage, balance, and weight are plausible.
The declared material is dominant and supplies the only visible rank.
Physical construction cues establish the material beyond palette.
Any supernatural material behaviour is bounded and never becomes full-object glow.
Finish, wear, lighting, background, and construction follow the accepted profile.
Every declared negative constraint is satisfied.
